reviews.resource_scope: Verified tenant/account, one hospital, selected Staff and employment review; exact frozen person finding, terms/evidence and actual current scoped-Staff or nonclinical owner/grant source.
reviews.rationale: The candidate consumer admits genuine current scoped Staff authority or a separately validated current IAM owner/exact employment preparation/review grant. Compound preparation/document grants remain required on the Staff preparation path; its actor/link and assignment evidence are retained. Governance has no Staff/link alias: the matching hospital-only capability, subject, tenant, hospital, selected Staff/review, source grant/version or owner membership, membership incarnation, owner count and lease are bound into private purpose. Exact workspace assertions and one shared five-second budget apply; no alternative-source fallback follows a business callback, source change or dependency failure. WF0105 adds private proof to head/history: immutable-source validation runs before trusted proof recording, before history capture; the Go entry verifies matching enabled source and recorder triggers before disclosure. Restrictive purpose policies cover all current tenant-scoped Workforce tables, preventing inherited owner/manager access from widening selected reads or enabling master/payroll/clinical writes. Only guarded review/history/frozen children, the owner-maintained cohort and attributable audit may be written. Human contributor/historical-link/declared-subject independence, current frozen source and CAS/receipt rules remain enforced. Evidence transfer compares both tagged authority and frozen basis after storage I/O before releasing bytes. Public responses/events omit private proof. This source classification is not database, UI, activation or production acceptance; the actual remote test first returned 403 after real term preparation, scanning and grant approval. New WF0105 remains unapplied and unapproved for live rollout. Prerequisite inspection also requires matching history snapshot/immutability guards and forced RLS plus the restrictive private-purpose policy on every current tenant-scoped Workforce table. Missing policy/recording support denies before disclosure; a future table must acquire its default-deny or selected-purpose policy before governance consumers resume. Canonical-audit/deletion review: the decision action is workforce.employment_review.decided with the resulting status; separate restrictive DELETE policies prevent readable master rows from being deleted. Entry also requires that the runtime role lacks TRUNCATE privilege on the protected tables. Candidate 121a3495 passed frozen submission/replay, exact-grant rejection and protected detail before its decision audit was refused; the corrected full scenario remains pending. Source rechecked for WF0112: the new closed targets operation alone omits selected Staff; all existing draft operations retain their real Staff/period/command/source/write boundaries. The new route is separate and no existing registration or permission changes. Source rechecked for WF0113: separate selected employment-document routes use the same exact native preparation source lifecycle and an independent closed purpose. Canonical document mutation hooks are no-ops for existing gates; the old Staff/pharmacy/source/permission and business-state checks remain. Native document support is a candidate, not runtime acceptance. Source rechecked for WF0114: separate selected native employment binding routes reuse the canonical evidence engine under a dedicated current-source purpose; preparation command capture remains nil on existing Staff/pharmacy scopes. Only native protected-file gates use the new explicit transaction/refresh branch. Prior route permissions and Staff/intake authority remain unchanged. Canonical contributor, revision, released-byte and withdrawal checks remain mandatory; database/storage acceptance is still pending. Source rechecked for candidate native hospital assignment admission (IAM0049) on 2026-11-14: existing Workforce Routes and owner-only IAM assignment registrations retain their admission. The new hospital route uses a separate guarded source and restrictive selection. The added fixed assignment capability mapping does not alter existing person, employment or link template mappings. New native verification consumers do not replace the legacy manager protocol. This source review does not establish runtime acceptance of the new route or consumers. Source rechecked for candidate assignment-authority discovery on 2026-11-14: existing Workforce route registrations are unchanged. The added separate sealed-filtered list authenticates the selected account and verifies each candidate through the exact current IAM governance source before rereading its name. It creates no Staff actor and does not grant an existing employment, person or operating permission. New discovery runtime acceptance remains pending. Finding-file isolation source review: Workforce module appends migration 0115; registrations and the module tail after Routes are byte-identical. The corrected invoker helper keeps the same finding-source/evidence predicate and returns false before evidence access for other contexts. No scanner grants or existing route authority expand. Real worker/rollback acceptance is pending CI. WF0118 source rechecked: a missing private operating-selection purpose returns false before planning its Staff lookup; the complete authorized SELECT remains byte-identical. The migration requires prior integrity true and refreshes the same policy/function coverage after the approved definition change. No authority result is cached, no policy/permission/data changes, and cold lifecycle acceptance remains pending. Source rechecked for qualified assignment target composition: existing route bodies are unchanged; module registration adds IAM0052/Workforce0119 with separate read-only purposes. Runtime acceptance of the new chooser remains pending and is not inherited by this review. Source rechecked for #1703 Staff MFA recovery on 2026-11-19: IAM module changes only append migration0053; Workforce adds the recovery dependency and route registration, and its handlers struct adds that dependency. Existing registered handlers, admission and scope checks are unchanged. New credential-recovery surfaces are classified separately. This source check does not establish native/runtime acceptance.
remaining: Complete current-head PostgreSQL/FGA acceptance for both authority alternatives, inherited-manager denial, source/target replacement, dependency failures, immutable source/history and post-I/O revocation; preserve all prior evidence through rollback.

Complete governance-aware discovery/inbox/selection, selected draft/document authoring and reviewer UI; adopt first activation and assignment settlement without synthetic Staff actors or legacy elevation.
Complete deterministic generation-admission lock races and independently reviewed legacy/bootstrap/governance cohorts before enabling activation.
Complete production reviewer-workspace acceptance, normal browser generation-consumption acceptance and every suspension/exit/expiry/rehire cutoff without legacy or cleanup bypasses.
Complete production Staff Admin/reviewer UI/provider/scanner acceptance and signed-session race/outage/two-hospital enforcement across all affected consumers.
